items.title: DATA Network to migrate to Sui, retire own chain
items.desc: The migration is backed by a $30 million investment from Sui Foundation.

items.title: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
items.desc: Holders could face fines of up to 10,000 euros for failing to declare qualifying assets.

items.title: Former Acting Chair Caroline Pham says CFTC can regulate almost everything except ‘onions and box office receipts’
items.desc: Pham said the CFTC's recent proposals are 'absolutely the kind of protection' needed for crypto retail traders in the United States.

items.title: XRP Ledger defends emergency patch for unlimited XRP bug
items.desc: The XRP Ledger Foundation pushed back against claims that its emergency security patch was forced on network operators.

items.title: Justin Sun says Tron’s post-quantum cryptography has gone live on testnet
items.desc: “We’re ready to bring quantum resistance to mainnet at any time,” Sun said in a post on X.

items.title: Trader nets $1.28 million on new 1,000x exchange Papertrade by moving Hyperliquid’s ETH prices
items.desc: The same wallet later lost $450,000 when 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night after staying open for more than three hours.

items.title: Ledger User Reports Hardware Implant in Wallet Bought in Europe
items.desc: Ledger says all confirmed cases tied to its October 9 fund-draining investigation involve Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which has halted hardware-wallet sales.

items.title: XRP Ledger patches decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP
items.desc: An overflow bug in the XRP Ledger's payment engine could have let an attacker mint about 18 trillion spendable XRP in one transaction.

items.title: Coinbase Completes Deribit Integration for Institutional Traders
items.desc: Former International Exchange clients gain Deribit's options suite and margin system, while US Prime options trading follows a separate rollout.

items.title: Ledger Says All Confirmed Draining Cases Involve CryptoBilis-Sold Devices
items.desc: The company says its direct sales channels are unaffected and reminds resellers never to restock returned products.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
items.desc: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.

items.title: Liquid Bitcoin Redemptions Remain Frozen With 85.8% Reserve Coverage
items.desc: The reserve gap is about 603 BTC. Liquid says peg-outs require full backing and completed security reviews before they can restart.

items.title: Papertrade Says It Is Tightening Trading Limits After Manipulation Allegations
items.desc: The team says it is restricting exposure onchain and through relayers. Its statement does not confirm claims that a trader was blacklisted or prevented from closing positions.

items.title: PeckShield Traces $3.89 Million in Ledger Theft Funds to Binance Deposits
items.desc: The reported Tron deposits offer investigators an exchange-account lead, but intermediary wallets handling other clients’ money complicate attribution.

items.title: US Bitcoin ETFs Shed $679 Million in Weekly Reversal
items.desc: Withdrawals on Oct. 7–8 drove a $920 million swing from the preceding week, leaving the two-week flow total negative.

items.title: Coldcard says it’s investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
items.desc: Company advised users not to visit or interact with the link in question and said it will share any further verified updates.

items.title: COLDCARD Warns of Phishing Post on Its Official X Account
items.desc: The company says it found no matching login record. A researcher found the fake migration site was built to collect wallet recovery phrases.

items.title: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant, says losses may exceed $86M
items.desc: Ledger said the incident appeared to be isolated to a single reseller and its Southeast Asian market.

items.title: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
items.desc: The two measures attempt to set the stage for a potential US Supreme Court battle over federal and state jurisdiction.

items.title: Filecoin Nears End of Six-Year Vesting, Removing 68 Million FIL in Annual Releases
items.desc: At the latest mining pace, annualized additions from vesting and block rewards would fall from about 89 million FIL to 21 million. Storage-provider rewards continue.

items.title: Papertrade Faces Oracle-Manipulation Allegation as House Pool Shows $3.14 Million
items.desc: The cited wallet showed about $1.73 million in realized trading gains on PaperDash. Papertrade’s loss-funded pool pays winners, with unpaid profits queued if cash runs short.

items.title: Pump.fun to Tie Callout Rewards to Followers’ Profits
items.desc: Low-cap token recommendations will earn less under changes starting with the Oct. 10 payout, co-founder Alon said.

items.title: Papertrade Traders Lose $18.2 Million as Staking Rewards Reach $12.6 Million
items.desc: Reported staking rewards equaled about 69% of net trading losses, but the payouts redistribute money to PAPER stakers rather than reimburse each losing trader.

items.title: Ledger Says Affected User’s Device Contained Hardware Implant
items.desc: CryptoBilis has stopped selling all hardware wallet inventory pending the investigation, according to Ledger, widening an earlier pause request limited to Ledger devices.

items.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
items.desc: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the “swap” definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling—sharpening the agency’s claim to exclusive jurisdiction.

items.title: Papertrade Shows $10.3 Million in Staker Rewards Hours After Launch
items.desc: The 1000x-leverage venue’s dashboard showed roughly $5 million in its house pool and no queued payout debt as trading losses funded PAPER rewards.

items.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
items.desc: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families in Asia, Europe and the Middle East.

items.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
items.desc: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last week's trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

items.title: Papertrade Draws Reported $3 Billion in Positions in First Hour
items.desc: DefiLlama tracked $137.1 million in trader balances and house liquidity combined. Those funds are not all available to pay winning trades.

items.title: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
items.desc: A National Assembly committee adopted amendments taxing stablecoin swaps and crypto exits by wealthy holders, then rejected the 2027 budget's revenue section.

items.title: StarkWare Calls Starknet L1 Shift Its 'Clearest Path Forward'
items.desc: Starknet still settles on Ethereum, and its official account described an L1 move as 'a question, not a decision' a day earlier.

items.title: Wallet Linked to CryptoBilis Thefts Routes 464 ETH to Tornado Cash
items.desc: Ethereum records show the money passed through an intermediary and four deposit wallets, while the source address retained about 700 ETH.

items.title: Papertrade Sets 1000x Perps Launch With $85 Million Deposited
items.desc: Trading is scheduled for 10 a.m. ET on Oct. 10. User deposits are separate from the house-side pool, which starts at zero and grows from traders’ losses.
